task_description.overview: Compute and plot the amplitude and phase frequency response of a seismometer given its poles, zeros, and scale factor.
steps: Load the poles, zeros, and scale factor of the seismometer.
Compute the complex frequency response using an FFT-based method (e.g., paz_to_freq_resp).
Convert the unwrapped phase from range [-π, π] to [0, 2π].
Plot the amplitude response on a log–log frequency scale.
Plot the phase response on a semilogarithmic frequency scale with y-axis ticks at multiples of π.
Adjust plot layout, add axis labels, title, and display the figure.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Given the poles, zeros, scale factor, sampling interval, and number of FFT points of a seismometer, compute its frequency response using the paz_to_freq_resp function from obspy.signal.invsim. Then unwrap the phase to range from 0 to 2π, and generate two subplots: (1) amplitude vs. frequency on a log–log scale, (2) phase vs. frequency on a semilog scale with y-ticks at 0, π/2, π, 3π/2, and 2π. Label axes and add a suptitle 'Frequency Response of LE-3D/1s Seismometer'. Save the frequency response plot to {frequency_response_plot}.
